notes.title: Space God - Update #2 LOCAL CO-OP MODE ADDED!
notes.notes:
Update Note #2

- Local Cooperative mode is available now
- Added kill announcement in Warfare mode
- Added default weapon of ships
- Increased default starcoins: 5000 Starcoins
- New language support: Русский (Russian)
